claim: The geometry three or more bodies are arranged into. Without a stated shape a group prompt collapses into tag soup and overlapping limbs; line reads as ceremony, wedge as aggression, isolated_one as exclusion.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: multiple boys, standing in a row, straight line, evenly spaced
multiple boys, v formation, one in front, others flanking behind
multiple boys, huddled together, tight group, bunched
multiple boys, standing in a circle, ring formation
multiple boys, scattered, spread apart, irregular spacing
multiple boys, front row kneeling, back row standing, tiered rows
multiple boys, one boy apart from the group, isolated figure, group behind

look_at: line/cluster/scattered/tiered read; circle becomes the stadium ring; isolated_one never isolates.
